$schema_desc: Machine-readable pin of the mem0 v3 contract used by Smartware's mem0-compat adapter. Generated from mem0's own guides/release notes; regenerable; line-level source traceability in 'provenance'.
contract_generation: mem0 v3 (new memory algorithm: single-pass ADD-only extraction, multi-signal hybrid retrieval, entity linking; graph memory Platform-only)

mem0_repo.note: Vendored extracts are permitted under Apache-2.0 with attribution (see NOTICE at implementation).

sources.what: OSS SDK breaking changes (Python + TypeScript), removed-parameters reference, common issues, graceful degradation
Platform v3 endpoints, search param changes, response shapes, SDK client cleanup, backward compatibility
Mem0 Node SDK v3.0.0 release notes (camelCase, topK, filters, customInstructions, removed params, getAll envelope)
mem0 CLI command contract and MEM0_BASE_URL env override
Hosted mem0 MCP server tool set and auth

published_surface_versions.note: Python OSS v3 documented but NOT published on PyPI as of extraction date; TS SDK v3 published.

primary_v3_endpoints.note: Async: poll GET /v1/event/{event_id}/ -> status SUCCEEDED or FAILED

primary_v3_endpoints.request_body: query: string; filters: {user_id, agent_id, run_id} (optional keys); top_k: int 1-1000 default 10 (optional); threshold: float in [0,1] default 0.1 (optional; 0.0 disables); rerank: bool default false (optional)

primary_v3_endpoints.query_params: page: int default 1; page_size: int default first page

legacy_surfaces_keep_working.note: V1 and V2 endpoints continue to work per mem0 backward-compat promise.
legacy_surfaces_keep_working.oss_shape_routes_reference: spec sub 2.1 (G1-derived from mem0ai 2.x server; re-verify at implementation)

rest.entity_ids_rule: Top-level entity IDs in search/get_all raise (REST 400; SDKs ValueError/throw). add()/delete_all() keep top-level entity IDs.
rest.relations_field: No longer returned in v3 (graph memory Platform-only). Must not be fabricated.

python_oss_breaking: inside filters dict; top-level raises ValueError
must be str/dict/list[dict]; else Mem0ValidationError VALIDATION_003
python_client_sdk_breaking: async by default, v1.1 always; params removed
api_version, output_format, async_mode, filter_memories, keyword_search, force_add_only, batch_size, immutable, includes, excludes, enable_graph, org_name, project_name, org_id, project_id
typescript_client_sdk_breaking: OutputFormat enum, API_VERSION enum, organizationId, projectId, organizationName, projectName, enableGraph, asyncMode, outputFormat, immutable, filterMemories, batchSize, forceAddOnly, includes, excludes, keywordSearch

global_flags.agent: --agent/--json sanitized output, errors as JSON, non-zero exit

cli.note: Existing mem0 CLI can repoint to the compat server via MEM0_BASE_URL with no code change.

mcp.tools_verification_note: Docs page extraction truncated at update_memory; verify exact live set via tools/list at implementation and update this fixture.
mcp.auth: API key as bearer token or browser sign-in; 401 Authentication required otherwise

verification_notes: All registry versions verified via PyPI/npm listing 2026-08-29; mem0 repo commit via GitHub API; archived flag via GitHub API (archived: true).
OSS Python v3 is documented but not published on PyPI (mem0ai latest = 2.0.19). Python conformance must assert v3 semantics from docs and validate legacy surface with 2.0.19.

mem0 v3 benchmark claims (LoCoMo 71.4->91.6, LongMemEval 67.8->93.4, extraction latency ~2.0s->~1.0s p50) are mem0's own reported numbers; not independently verified by Smartware; not part of the compat contract/conformance.
This fixture defines behavioral shape only. Retrieval ranking/score parity is explicitly OUT of scope (spec 6; G0 verdict in spec 11.1).
